newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market ends higher,refineries in focus.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market ends higher,refineries in focus.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed higher on Monday with foreign and local investors focusing on high caps, mainly oil refineries and cement makers, traders said.
They said demand on heavy weights would continue over the next few days, but expected a correction by the week's end.
Three independent indices which measure the performance of Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market hit new record highs on Monday due to higher prices of blue chips.

The VAB-RA all-share index, computed by Vanguard securities, gained 3.7 percent from Friday to 5,866.4 points and BIG-OTC, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group, went up by 4.1 percent to 4,714.28. Creditanstalt Securities' CAS-RQ firmed by 3.98 percent to 1,068 points.
Petrobrazi oil refinery, a market star over the past months closed 1,000 lei up at 56,000 lei, while Arpechim refinery closed 4,000 lei up at 51,000, under strong buying pressure.
Cement maker Romcim gained 12,000 lei, closing at 130,000, and cement maker Moldocim ended 2,000 lei higher at 50,000.
Overall turnover was 31.9 billion lei, up from 24.3 billion on Friday.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CRAS02 and CRAS03. ($=7,103 lei)
